# Provisional Validation Report: Elevator Predictive Maintenance Retrofit

## Summary
**Provisional verdict**: The concept receives a provisional verdict of **NEEDS_WORK** with a composite score of **4.0** and **LOW confidence (0.12)**. The assessment decision reason is **INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE**. While technical partial feasibility exists in open repositories and predictive elevator maintenance IoT solutions are active in the market, community demand signals returned completely empty, and legal/regulatory inspection displacement remains an unaddressed gap.

## Approved Scope
- **Startup Idea**: A subscription service that fits retrofit vibration sensors to commercial building lifts and warns facilities managers of bearing wear weeks before a breakdown, replacing the fixed quarterly inspection contracts most landlords buy today.
- **Category**: Elevator predictive maintenance
- **Target User**: Commercial building facilities managers
- **Problem**: Lifts suffer unexpected bearing failures and downtime between scheduled visits, while building operators pay for fixed quarterly maintenance contracts that do not provide continuous health visibility.
- **Technology Claim**: Non-invasive retrofit vibration sensors and vibration anomaly algorithms can identify bearing wear weeks before mechanical breakdown occurs.
- **As of Date**: 2026-09-06

## Five-Score Rubric Breakdown
- **Demand (D): 1/5** (Evidence thin)
  - *Anchor*: Evidence does not reach this question — the sentiment branch returned fewer than 5 usable threads and no problem thread.
- **Market (M): 2/5** (Evidence thin)
  - *Anchor*: At least 1 market source names a buyer segment for this problem ([OXMaint](https://oxmaint.com/industries/facility-management/connected-elevator-maintenance-iot-monitoring)). Additional industry commentary points to retrofit IoT modules detecting abnormal readings before breakdown ([LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/from-reactive-predictive-future-elevator-maintenance-india-pmknf), [Medium](https://medium.com/uptime-ac/elevator-predictive-maintenance-from-words-to-reality-5f7de43b951c)).
- **Competitive Room (C): 2/5** (Evidence thin)
  - *Anchor*: No source states an axis of beatability, and either no competitor is named or at least 1 named competitor is not shown to be vendor owned ([OXMaint](https://oxmaint.com/industries/facility-management/connected-elevator-maintenance-iot-monitoring)).
- **Feasibility (F): 3/5** (Evidence thin)
  - *Anchor*: At least 1 repository in the feasibility evidence is reusable: marked SOLVES_ENTIRELY or PARTIAL, licensed for commercial use, and pushed within 12 months ([holden-mcgorin/UniPHM](https://github.com/holden-mcgorin/UniPHM)). Multiple other repos lack commercial licenses or are unmaintained ([zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection](https://github.com/zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection), [wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet](https://github.com/wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet), [LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp](https://github.com/LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp)).
- **Headroom Over Free (X): 3/5** (Evidence thin)
  - *Anchor*: No free substitute repository exists, and free coverage is unsettled or settled at no more than a separable part of the core job ([OXMaint](https://oxmaint.com/industries/facility-management/connected-elevator-maintenance-iot-monitoring)).

## Verdict & Confidence
- **Verdict**: NEEDS_WORK
- **Decision Reason**: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
- **Composite Score**: 4.0
- **Confidence**: 0.12 (LOW)
- **Provisional**: true

## Evidence Gaps
- Legal and insurance requirements governing whether statutory physical elevator inspections can legally be displaced or reduced by continuous monitoring systems.
- The sentiment tool branch returned tool_status `empty` with zero usable threads or comments from the query `predictive maintenance IoT`.

## Risks
- **Thin Evidence Across All Dimensions**: Evidence thin flags are active across Demand, Market, Competitive Room, Feasibility, and Headroom Over Free.
- **Failed Sentiment Branch**: The sentiment branch returned no usable discussions or validation signals (`tool_status: empty`), leaving organic buyer pull unverified.
- **Unresolved Legal/Insurance Scoping Gap**: The evidence does not show whether statutory scheduled physical maintenance can legally or contractually be replaced by continuous monitoring.
- **Licensing and Maintenance Hazards in Tech Base**: Repositories such as [zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection](https://github.com/zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection) (89 months unmaintained), [wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet](https://github.com/wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet) (74 months unmaintained), and [LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp](https://github.com/LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp) do not permit commercial use.
- **Existing Market Solutions**: Incumbents such as [OXMaint](https://oxmaint.com/industries/facility-management/connected-elevator-maintenance-iot-monitoring) already market IoT motor health, ride quality, and predictive maintenance alerts to facilities managers.

## Kill Criteria
- Elevator safety codes or municipal jurisdictional laws mandate physical quarterly inspections by certified technicians regardless of continuous IoT vibration monitoring.
- Commercial building property insurance policies deny liability coverage or increase premiums if scheduled physical technician visits are replaced or reduced.
- Elevator OEMs legally void equipment warranties or claim exclusive maintenance rights when third-party retrofit vibration sensors are attached to hoist machinery.

## Cheapest Next Test
Interview 5 commercial facilities managers and review standard elevator service contracts to verify whether statutory regulations and insurer policies allow reducing physical quarterly technician inspections when continuous vibration monitoring is present.

## Sources

- [OXMaint](https://oxmaint.com/industries/facility-management/connected-elevator-maintenance-iot-monitoring): "Prevent elevator breakdowns with IoT monitoring and AI. Track ride quality, door cycles & motor health for proactive maintenance alerts."
- [Medium](https://medium.com/uptime-ac/elevator-predictive-maintenance-from-words-to-reality-5f7de43b951c): "Elevator predictive maintenance: from words to reality How predictive maintenance can solve the global elevator problem, if executed with the right product vision. Our previous article explored how …"
- [GitHub - holden-mcgorin/UniPHM](https://github.com/holden-mcgorin/UniPHM): Reusable partial bearing fault detection repository, pushed within 10 months and commercially licensed.
- [GitHub - zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection](https://github.com/zhangxiaoling/Bearing-fault-detection): Bearing fault detection repository, non-commercial license, 89 months unmaintained.
- [GitHub - wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet](https://github.com/wargod797/Fault_diagnosis_ballbearing_wavelet): Bearing fault diagnosis repository, non-commercial license, 74 months unmaintained.
- [GitHub - LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp](https://github.com/LGDiMaggio/predictive-maintenance-mcp): Predictive maintenance repository, non-commercial license.
- [GitHub - VictorBauler/awesome-bearing-dataset](https://github.com/VictorBauler/awesome-bearing-dataset): Bearing dataset repository, commercially licensed.
